title: The Colomo-Pronko conjecture for frozen-corner alternating sign matrices
summary: We prove the Colomo-Pronko conjecture for alternating sign matrices with a prescribed square of zeros at a corner, for all matrix sizes and freezing parameters. A known multiple-integral formula for the frozen-corner count yields determinant representations built from fixed polynomial kernels. We relate these kernels to the conjectured determinant through an inverse identity for the commutator of a signed Pascal matrix with reversal.
